Black Magic Pizza opens permanent Milk District space just in time for the holidays

The neo-Neapolitan pizza pop-up that has scores under its spell will build on its (oc)cult-like following
by Faiyaz Kara November 22, 2026November 22, 2026

Share this:

  • Email a link to a friend (Opens in new window) Email
  • Share on Reddit (Opens in new window) Reddit
  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window) X
  • Share on Nextdoor (Opens in new window) Nextdoor
  • Share on Bluesky (Opens in new window) Bluesky
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:50
Instaread

Christmas has come early for pizza aficionados.

Black Magic Pizza will open in their permanent space this week, moving across the street from where they served their gorgeous, blistered pies out of the food window at Whiskey Lou’s, and into the endcap space next to The Milkhouse at 207 N. Bumby Ave. (map) in the Milk District.

“After the last three years of building our business out of a small takeout window, we’re finally taking the next big step,” said owner Traviss Santos, who runs Black Magic Pizza with partner Elizabeth Hill.

“This is a huge milestone for us. We’ve spent the last three years growing Black Magic Pizza one pie at a time, building relationships with our customers and becoming part of this neighborhood. We’re incredibly excited to finally have a space of our own and continue growing right here in Orlando.”

And they’re not the only ones. The pizza outfit has drawn a legion of fans (me included) for their hybrid pies fusing Neapolitan cooking techniques with New York-style pizza ingredients cooked in an MPM PizzaMaster Deck Oven where temperatures can approach 900 degrees.

Join today because you love us, too

The wee space that held Arepas and More and MX Taco before that has been given a throwback design with wood paneling, a pay phone and retro Toshiba TV with built-in DVD player. Yeah, so go ahead and pop in your copy of Do The Right Thing or Mystic Pizza while enjoying one of the finest 12- and 18-inch rounds you’ll find in the city.

Black Magic Pizza will stage a Friends & Family night on on Black Friday (Nov. 27), followed by their first public soft opening on Saturday, Nov. 28, and Sunday, Nov. 29.

Expect lines out the door.

And, if you’re not already, be sure to follow @blackmagicpizza or visit blackmagicpizza.com for more.
